# Jericho Writers

> > Jericho Writers is a comprehensive creative writing education and editorial services platform offering courses, mentoring, and professional manuscript editing for aspiring and published authors.

Jericho Writers provides structured learning pathways for writers at all levels, from novel writing fundamentals to self-publishing and traditional publishing strategies. The platform combines expert-led courses, professional editorial services, and a premium membership community to support authors through every stage of their writing journey.

## Key Topics

- Novel Writing
- Creative Writing Courses
- Manuscript Editing

- Self-Publishing

- Premium Membership

## Creative Writing Courses

- [Creative writing courses: Start Learning Today](https://jerichowriters.com/creative-writing-courses): Main courses hub offering online creative writing programs for all levels
- [Ultimate Novel Writing Programme: how to plan, write, edit & publish](https://jerichowriters.com/creative-writing-courses/ultimate-novel-writing-programme): Year-long novel writing course with mentoring and literary agent access
- [Novel Writing Course: Write a novel in 8 months](https://jerichowriters.com/creative-writing-courses/novel-writing-course): 8-month novel writing course with one-to-one expert support and feedback
- [Writing Romance Novels with Rowan Coleman](https://jerichowriters.com/creative-writing-courses/writing-romance-novels-course): 6-week romance writing course led by Sunday Times bestselling author
- [Writing Crime and Thriller Novels with Graham Bartlett](https://jerichowriters.com/creative-writing-courses/writing-crime-and-thriller-novels): 6-week crime and thriller writing course with former Chief Superintendent
- [Path to Publication: Navigate the world of traditional publishing](https://jerichowriters.com/creative-writing-courses/path-to-publication): Traditional publishing course covering submissions, pitching and author branding
- [Self-Editing Course: Polish Your Manuscript](https://jerichowriters.com/creative-writing-courses/self-editing-course): Self-editing course led by publishing professionals for manuscript polishing
- [Simply Self Publish: the ultimate self-pub course for indies](https://jerichowriters.com/creative-writing-courses/simply-self-publish-course): 10-week self-publishing course covering publication and marketing strategies
- [Video courses](https://jerichowriters.com/member-resources/video-courses): Premium membership video courses on novel writing, crime, memoir and YA
- [Course Tutors](https://jerichowriters.com/creative-writing-courses/course-tutors): Profiles of expert course tutors including published authors and agents

## Editorial Services

- [Editorial services for all novels, memoirs and non-fiction](https://jerichowriters.com/editorial-services): Main editorial services hub offering manuscript assessment and editing
- [Manuscript assessment from outstanding editors](https://jerichowriters.com/editorial-services/manuscript-assessment): Structural feedback service from expert editors for complete manuscripts
- [Developmental editing: use our editors to perfect your book](https://jerichowriters.com/editorial-services/developmental-editing): Developmental editing with structural feedback and in-text manuscript comments
- [Copy Editing Services: precise, insightful and professional](https://jerichowriters.com/editorial-services/copy-editing-services): Professional copy editing and proofreading by experienced editors
- [Agent Submission Pack: perfect your query letter & synopsis](https://jerichowriters.com/editorial-services/agent-submission-pack): Expert feedback on query letters and synopses for agent submissions
- [Short Story Review: get insightful & actionable feedback](https://jerichowriters.com/editorial-services/short-story-review): Professional editorial feedback on short stories from expert editors
- [Book Editors – for novels, non-fiction and manuscripts](https://jerichowriters.com/editors): Directory of professional freelance editors for books and manuscripts
